Echo Deck

Unbound Echo Deck

"The Wyld does not name us. It uses us."
Theme: Living answers without a stable self. You survive by adapting, masking, and turning pressure into motion.

HUNGER SHAPES THE PATH

Trigger: You pursue what you need and the world refuses to give it freely.

I — FOLLOW THE TRACE

Skill: Tracking
You find the freshest sign and keep it in your hands.

II — READ THE LAND

Skill: Navigation
You choose the route that the world least wants you to take.

III — FIND THE PATTERN

Skill: Investigation
You notice the repeating detail that reveals where the truth is hiding.

IV — MAKE DO AND MOVE

Skill: Survival
You improvise shelter, leverage, or a way through with what is available.

WEAR THE WORLD

Trigger: You must vanish, blend, or become part of the scene before it swallows you.

I — BECOME STILL

Skill: Concealment
You pick the perfect place to be forgotten.

II — MOVE UNSEEN

Skill: Stealth
You cross attention without giving it a handle.

III — SLIP THE GAP

Skill: Acrobatics
You pass where bodies should not pass.

IV — TAKE WHAT YOU NEED

Skill: Sleight of Hand
You steal seconds, objects, or small truths without starting a fight.

THE ROOM IS TERRITORY

Trigger: You enter a tense scene and someone must yield ground first.

I — SHOW TEETH

Skill: Intimidation
You make consequences feel close and real.

II — SET THE PACE

Skill: Leadership
You force order onto chaos so people follow a sequence you control.

III — KNOW THE UNDERCURRENT

Skill: Streetwise
You spot who truly runs this space and what they fear losing.

IV — CLAIM THE RIGHT

Skill: Etiquette
You use rule, rank, and ritual to corner them into behaving.

SPEAK LIKE A MASK

Trigger: You must steer perception to survive the next minute.

I — MAKE IT BELIEVABLE

Skill: Performance
You sell a role so well that doubt feels rude.

II — GIVE THEM A STORY

Skill: Deception
You provide the version they can accept while you keep the truth.

III — TURN THEM GENTLY

Skill: Persuasion
You guide them to the choice that keeps you alive.

IV — TOUCH THE REAL FEAR

Skill: Empathy
You find what they actually feel, then speak to that instead of their words.
